targets.original_statement_type:
∀ (n j : ℕ) (S : PowerSeries ℚ),
  S * ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedClearedDenominator n j) ^ 9 =
      ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedNumerator n j) →
    S = ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.clearedSeries n j

∀ (n j s : ℕ),
  j ≤ n →
    1 ≤ s →
      s ≤ 9 →
        ∀ (W : Polynomial ℚ),
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W =
            ∑ l ∈ Finset.Icc s 9,
              ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.localCoefficient n j l *
                (W.comp
                      (Polynomial.C (-↑j * ↑(n - j)) + Polynomial.C (↑n - 2 * ↑j) * Polynomial.X +
                        Polynomial.X ^ 2)).coeff
                  (l - s)

∀ (n j s : ℕ),
  j ≤ n →
    1 ≤ s →
      s ≤ 9 →
        ∀ (W : Polynomial ℤ),
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) W) =
            ∑ l ∈ Finset.Icc s 9,
              ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.localCoefficient n j l *
                ↑((W.comp (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.integerLocalU n j)).coeff (l - s))

limitations: Formal local quotient in Q[[z]] and nine finite coefficient convolution orders only.
No numerical evaluation or analytic convergence theorem for the infinite formal series.
No full LaurentSeries/RatFunc embedding or global partial-fraction decomposition.
No complete aggregate F map, reflection/cancellation result, or invertibility.
No exact infinite L identity, J certificate, or irrationality result.
Integer W supplies integer multiplier coefficients; actual lower local coefficients remain rational and may be nonintegral.
Arbitrary W can vanish; arbitrary local degree does not discharge global degree/growth restrictions.
